40015792.author: पदार्थः
40015792.content: राजपुत्रः king's son, प्रतापवान् powerful, अतिबलः very strong, सःरामः Rama, तस्य his, गतिम् where about, अन्विच्छन् to know, दश ten, वानरयूथपान् Vanara troops, दिदेश assigned.

40015792.author: Translation
40015792.content: Rama, the son of the king, a powerful and strong warrior, ordered ten Vanaras to know the whereabouts (of Indrajith).

40015793.author: पदार्थः
40015793.content: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, सुषेणस्य to Sushena, द्वौ both, दायादौ Dwivida, प्लवगर्षपम् best of Vanaras, नीलंच and Neela, जाम्बवन्तंच and Jambavantha, अङ्गदम् Angada, तरस्विनम् courageous, शरभंच Sarabha, विनतंच Vinatha, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, महाबलम् mighty strong, सानुप्रस्थम् Sanuprastha, ऋषभंच and Rshabam, ऋषभस्कन्धम् Rshaba Skanda, आदिदेश ordered.

40015793.author: Translation
40015793.content: Rama, the scorcher of enemies, ordered the two sons of Sushena, the best of Vanaras Neela, Jambavantha, Angada, as well as courageous Sarabha, Vinatha, and Hanumantha and Sanuprastha endowed with extraordinary might, also Rshaba and Rshaba Skanda.

40015794.author: पदार्थः
40015794.content: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, सुषेणस्य to Sushena, द्वौ both, दायादौ Dwivida, प्लवगर्षपम् best of Vanaras, नीलंच and Neela, जाम्बवन्तंच and Jambavantha, अङ्गदम् Angada, तरस्विनम् courageous, शरभंच Sarabha, विनतंच Vinatha, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, महाबलम् mighty strong, सानुप्रस्थम् Sanuprastha, ऋषभंच and Rshabam, ऋषभस्कन्धम् Rshaba Skanda, आदिदेश ordered.

40015794.author: Translation
40015794.content: Rama, the scorcher of enemies, ordered the two sons of Sushena, the best of Vanaras Neela, Jambavantha, Angada, as well as courageous Sarabha, Vinatha, and Hanumantha and Sanuprastha endowed with extraordinary might, also Rshaba and Rshaba Skanda.

40015795.author: पदार्थः
40015795.content: सर्वे all, तेहरयः those monkeys, सम्प्रहृष्टाः exceedingly delighted, भीमान् huge, मार्गमाणा searching, दिशोदशः ten directions, पादपान् held huge trees, आकाशं sky, विविशुस्सर्वे sprang.

40015795.author: Translation
40015795.content: All those monkeys, exceedingly rejoiced, held huge trees, and went in ten directions searching and sprang to the sky.

40015796.author: पदार्थः
40015796.content: अस्त्रवित् skilled in the use of weapons, रावणिः Ravana's son, परमास्तै: expert in mystic weapons, वेगवत्तरैः endowed with speed, इषुभिः arrows, वेगवताम् charged with energy, तेषाम् them, वेगम् swiftly, वारयामास prohibited

40015796.author: Translation
40015796.content: Ravana's son being skilled in the use of weapons and an expert in mystic powers, he prohibited the speed of the Vanaras with his swift arrows.

40015797.author: पदार्थः
40015797.content: नाराचैः iron arrows, क्षतविग्रहाः mangled, भीमवेगाः endowed with high speed, हरयः Vanaras, अन्धकारे in utter darkness, तम् him, Indrajith मेघैः cloud, आवृतम् covered, सूर्यमिव like Sun, नददृशुः not seen.

40015797.author: Translation
40015797.content: The Vanaras were mangled with iron arrows, however endowed with high speed they could not make out Indrajith in utter darkness just as the sun covered by clouds.

40015798.author: पदार्थः
40015798.content: समितिञ्जयः ever victorious, रावणिः Indrajith, सर्वदेहभिदः all over the body, शरान् arrows, भृशम् repeatedly, रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव on Rama and Lakshmana, आवेशयामास pierced.

40015798.author: Translation
40015798.content: Indrajith who is ever victorious, pierced repeatedly arrows all over the body of Rama and Lakshmana.

40015799.author: पदार्थः
40015799.content: वीरौ heroic, तौ they, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, क्रुद्धेन furious, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, शरताम् with arrows, गतैः pierced, पन्नगैः serpents, निरन्तरशरीरौ all over the body

40015799.author: Translation
40015799.content: Both Rama and Lakshmana were pierced by furious Indrajith with serpents like arrows furious.

40015800.author: पदार्थः
40015800.content: तयोः both of them, क्षतजमार्गेण wounded profusely, बहु excessively, रुधिरम् red with blood, सुस्राव flowing, तौ they, उभौ both, पुष्पितौ flowery, किंशुकौइव like Kimsuka trees, प्रकाशितौ looked bright.

40015800.author: Translation
40015800.content: Both Rama and Lakshmana bleeding excessively, wounded profusely, looked bright and red like Kimsuka trees with flowers.

40015801.author: पदार्थः
40015801.content: ततः then, पर्यन्तरक्ताक्षः corners of eyes turned red, भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः like a huge collyrium, रावणिः Ravana's son, अन्तर्धानगतः vanished, भ्रातरौ brothers, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40015801.author: Translation
40015801.content: Then Ravana's son with the corner of his eyes turned red in anger looking like a huge collyrium, vanished from there and spoke these words to the two brothers, Rama, and Lakshmana.

40015802.author: पदार्थः
40015802.content: अनालक्षयम् who has fire like eyes, युध्यमानम् while fighting war, त्रिदशेश्वरः Lord of gods, शक्रोऽपि Indra also, द्रष्टुम् to see, आसादितुंनापि cannot discern, नशक्तः not possible, युवाम् for you, किंपुनः why again

40015802.author: Translation
40015802.content: Indrajith who had fire like eyes, said," even the ruler of gods cannot discern while I am fighting war, why speak about you? It is not possible."

40015803.author: पदार्थः
40015803.content: राघवौ Raghava brothers, कङ्कपत्रिणा plumes of arrows, शरजालेन by the fire of arrows, प्रावृतौ enmeshed, रोषपरीतात्मा my anger, एषः in that way, यमसादनम् to the abode of Lord of death, नयामि am about to senddispatch you.

40015803.author: Translation
40015803.content: "Raghava brothers! You are enmeshed with plumes of arrows all over the body. My anger will not go waste. I will send you to the abode of Yama, the Lord of death."

40015804.author: पदार्थः
40015804.content: धर्मज्ञौ righteous, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having been told, शितैः stood, बाणैः arrows, निर्बिभेद paining, प्रजहर्ष rejoiced, ननादच roaring aloud.

40015804.author: Translation
40015804.content: Indrajith having spoken to the righteous brothers Rama and Lakshmana in that way, began to pain them with arrows and stood rejoiced roaring aloud.

40015805.author: पदार्थः
40015805.content: भिन्नाञ्जनचयश्यामः like a crushed black hill, विपुलम् huge, धनुः bow, विस्फार्यः mounting, महामृथे great conflict, भूयोभूय again and again, घोरान् terrific, शरान् arrows, विससर्ज released.

40015805.author: Translation
40015805.content: Indrajith who was like a mass of crushed black hill, mounting the huge bow released terrific arrows again and again in that great conflict.

40015806.author: पदार्थः
40015806.content: मर्मज्ञः vital, वीरः warrior, ततः thereafter, रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, मर्मसु vital parts, निशितान् sharp, शरान् arrows, मज्जयन् digging, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, ननादच kept roaring.

40015806.author: Translation
40015806.content: There after that warrior went on digging sharp arrows into the vital parts of Rama and Lakshmana again and again and kept roaring.

40015807.author: पदार्थः
40015807.content: रणमूर्धनि facing the battle, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a fraction of twinkling of an eye, बद्धौ bound, तौउभौ both of them, उदीक्षितुम् to retaliate, नशेकतुः not have energy.

40015807.author: Translation
40015807.content: In a fraction of a second, both Rama and Lakshmana facing the battle were bound by arrows and did not have energy to retaliate.

40015808.author: पदार्थः
40015808.content: ततः and then, विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ pierced all over the body, शरशल्याचितौ with heads of arrows, कृतौ staggered, रज्जुमुक्तौ freed from their cords, प्रकम्पितौ violently, महेन्द्रस्य Indra's ध्वजाविव like banners, सम्प्रचलितौ shaking, वीरौ heroes, मर्मभेदेन in vital parts, कर्शितौ pained, महेष्वासौ gallant princes, जगतीपती Lords of the world, तौ both, जगत्याम् world, निपेततुः fell.

40015808.author: Translation
40015808.content: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.

40015809.author: पदार्थः
40015809.content: ततः and then, विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ pierced all over the body, शरशल्याचितौ with heads of arrows, कृतौ staggered, रज्जुमुक्तौ freed from their cords, प्रकम्पितौ violently, महेन्द्रस्य Indra's ध्वजाविव like banners, सम्प्रचलितौ shaking, वीरौ heroes, मर्मभेदेन in vital parts, कर्शितौ pained, महेष्वासौ gallant princes, जगतीपती Lords of the world, तौ both, जगत्याम् world, निपेततुः fell.

40015809.author: Translation
40015809.content: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.

40015810.author: पदार्थः
40015810.content: वीरशयने warrior's bed, शयानौ bed, रुधिरोक्षितौ drenched in blood, शरवेष्टितसर्वाङ्गै all their limbs covered with arrows, परमपीडितौ highly distressed, तौवीरौ those warriors, आर्तौ lying.

40015810.author: Translation
40015810.content: The princes were lying on the warrior's bed in the battlefield, their limbs fully covered with arrows, in a highly distressed state.

40015811.author: पदार्थः
40015811.content: योः their, गात्रे in the body, अविद्धम् not wounded, अङ्गुळमात्रम् not even finger breadth space (an inch of space), अन्तरम् all over, नबभूव remained without being pierced, अजिह्मगैः unhurt, आकराग्रात् not even a part of the body was left, अनिर्भिन्नम् not wounded, अस्तब्दम् unshaken, न not.

40015811.author: Translation
40015811.content: Not an inch of space on their bodies remained without being pierced. Not even a part of the body was left unshaken, unhurt, or wounded.

40015812.author: पदार्थः
40015812.content: क्रूरेण by the cruel, कामरूपिणा capable of acquiring desired form, रक्षसा Rakshasa, निहतौ wounded, तौ both, प्रस्रवणौ flowed, जलम् इव like water, तीव्रम् copiously, असृक् vital breaths, सुस्रुवतुः brought forth.

40015812.author: Translation
40015812.content: Wounded by the cruel Rakshasas capable of changing form at their will, blood flowed from their body copiously like water from spring bringing out their vital life breaths.

40015813.author: पदार्थः
40015813.content: येन by whom, पुरा earlier, शक्रः Indra, विनिर्जितः utterly defeated, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, क्रोधात् in anger, मार्गणैः arrows, मर्मसु vital parts, विद्धः, रामः Rama, प्रधमम् first, पपात fell.

40015813.author: Translation
40015813.content: Rama fell first pierced by arrows in his vital parts released in anger by Indrajith, by whom Indra was utterly defeated.

40015814.author: पदार्थः
40015814.content: रुक्मपुङ्खैः coated with gold, प्रसन्नाग्रैः pure bright tips, अधोगतिभिः descending unobstructed like dust, आशुगैः quickly, नाराचैः with even and circular heads, अर्थनाराचैः halfmoon shaped heads, भल्लैः axe like heads, अञ्जलिकैरपि heads like joined palms, वत्सदन्तैश्च heads resembling teeth of calf, सिंहदंष्ट्रैः like lion's teeth, तथा in the same way, क्षुरैः heads as sharp as a razor, विव्याध hurt.

40015814.author: Translation
40015814.content: Indrajith pierced Rama with arrows coated with gold and gold tipped arrows, which had even and circular heads, with halfmoon arrows, with axe like heads, heads like joined palms, heads resembling teeth of calf and lion teeth arrows as well as razor sharp arrows which descended quickly unobstructed like dust.

40015815.author: पदार्थः
40015815.content: सः he, Rama, विज्यम् quitting, भिन्नमुष्टिपरीणाहम् strung and bent at both ends, three places, रुक्मभूषितम् gold plated, कार्मुकम् bow, आदाय holding, वीरशयने hero's bed, शिश्ये relaxed.

40015815.author: Translation
40015815.content: Rama lay relaxed on the hero's bed quitting his goldplated bow strung and bent at both ends, and the middle.

40015816.author: पदार्थः
40015816.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तत्र there, बाणपातान्तरे at an arrow's throw, पतितम् fallen, पुरुषर्षभम् best of men, दृष्टवा beholding, जीविते life, निराशः disappointed, अभवत् remained.

40015816.author: Translation
40015816.content: Lakshmana remained beholding the best of men fallen at an arrow's throw disappointed at his life.

40015817.author: पदार्थः
40015817.content: कमलपत्राक्षम् lotus petal eyed, भ्रातरम् brother, रामम् at Rama, शरबन्धपरिक्षतम् pained by pierced arrows, धरणीतले on the ground, पतितम् fallen, दृष्टवा seeing, शुशोच grieved.

40015817.author: Translation
40015817.content: Lakshmana grieved seeing his elder brother Rama pierced by arrows, pained, and fallen on the ground.

40015818.author: पदार्थः
40015818.content: हरयश्चापि even the monkeys, तम् him, दृष्टवा beholding, परमम् very, सन्तापम् much stricken, गताः fallen, शोकार्ताः in agony, अश्रुपूरियलोचनाः their eyes filled with tears, घोरम् terrible, चुक्रुशुः shrieked.

40015818.author: Translation
40015818.content: Even the monkeys' eyes were filled with tears, very much stricken with grief seeing Rama fallen and shrieked.

40015819.author: पदार्थः
40015819.content: वायुसुतप्रमुख्याः wind god's son's army, तेवानराः the Vanaras, समागताः collected together, बद्धौ bound, वीरौपतितौ fallen heroes, शयानौ lying, तौ both, सम्परिवार्य surrounding, तस्थुः stood, आर्ताः despondent, परमम् extremely, विषादम् sorrow, जग्मुःच remained.

40015819.author: Translation
40015819.content: Hanuman's army of Vanaras collected together stood surrounding fallen princes lying on the ground, despondent and extremely sorrowful. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty fifth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
